name: glassbox-automl
description: Transparent NumPy-only AutoML, exposed as an IronClaw MCP tool.

tools.name: auto_fit
tools.description: Run end-to-end AutoML on a local CSV dataset. Pass the CSV as an on-disk path (csv_path) visible to the local MCP server. Returns a JSON report with EDA summary, model leaderboard, the best model, its hyperparameters, the cross-validation score, and feature importances.

csv_path.description: Filesystem path to a local CSV, for example data/_uploaded.csv.

target_column.description: Header name of the target column to predict.

time_budget.description: Soft wall-clock cap (seconds) for random search.

output_schema.description: AutoFit report. The MCP server returns this object directly on success; failures surface as MCP error responses. The CLI shim at glassbox.agent.mcp_tool wraps the same payload as {"ok": true, "report": ...} or {"ok": false, "error": ...}.
